meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Search claude-mem's persistent cross-session memory database. Use when user asks "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or needs work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索跨会话记忆数据库，快速找回历史工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从之前的对话中找回解决方案或上下文
copy.tagline_en: Search cross-session memory database to quickly retrieve past work
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to recall solutions or context from previous conversations

howto.what: 技能让Claude能检索所有历史会话的记忆。用户问起以前做过的事时，它会先用关键词搜出结果清单，挑出相关项后再获取完整内容来作答。
howto.when: 当用户问起之前会话的内容，比如“这个我们之前解决过吗？”、“上次是怎么做X的？”，或需要找回以前的成果时触发。

say.text: 我们之前解决过JWT认证问题吗？
say.note: 会搜索相关记忆并给出结果摘要。

say.text: 上次是怎么修复登录bug的？
say.note: 会按步骤搜索并展示当时做法。

say.text: 查一下上周项目里关于数据库的改动。
say.note: 会按日期搜索并列出相关内容。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude search the persistent cross-session memory database. When asked about past work, it searches for matching records, filters them, then fetches full details of selected items to answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, such as "did we already fix this?", "how did we solve X last time?", or needs work from earlier sessions.

say_en.text: Have we solved the JWT authentication issue before?
say_en.note: Searches memory and returns relevant results.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login bug last time?
say_en.note: Searches and shows the previous approach.

say_en.text: Find database changes in last week's project.
say_en.note: Searches by date and lists related items.
